# Change request 26 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Export: numbers, bodies and CSV
- Each note in `GET /api/export` now has exactly the keys `number`, `title`, `body`, `pinned`, `archived` and
  `createdAt`. `number` is the note's number as a JSON number; `body` is its body as a string (`""` when empty),
  with each line break as `\n`. Everything else about the JSON export is unchanged, and `?format=json` gives the
  same result.
- `GET /api/export?format=csv` returns the same notes in the same order as CSV, with status 200 and a
  `Content-Type` of `text/csv`:
  - the first line is `number,title,body,pinned,archived,createdAt`, then one line per note;
  - `pinned` and `archived` are `true` or `false`, and `createdAt` is as in the JSON export;
  - a value that contains a comma, a double quote or a line break is enclosed in double quotes, and each double quote
    inside it is doubled (for example `"Say ""hi"", Bob"`); other values are not quoted;
  - every line, the last one included, ends with CRLF (`\r\n`). Line breaks inside a body stay `\n`.
- Both formats are downloads: the response has the header `Content-Disposition: attachment;
  filename="notes-<user>.json"` or `attachment; filename="notes-<user>.csv"`.
- Any other `format` gives status 400. When nobody is signed in, every format gives status 401.
- The list page gets a link `Export CSV` to `/api/export?format=csv`, next to `Export`.

Usage: hozu <command> [options]

Commands:
  inspect <feature|id>      Print a feature's canonical IR and summary, or a component (ui.Button) with its uses
  why <target>              What it is, where (file:line), what uses it and what it affects: a declaration
                            (cart.addItem), a component (ui.Button), a state (cart.idle) with its transitions
                            and contracts, a view node (DevTools id or IR pointer) or a page (page:home)
  explain | locate | impact Deprecated: hozu why answers each (removed in 0.15)
  plan <route>              Derived render plan: regions, cache modes, hydration islands
  build                     Write dist/public, dist/server/render.js and dist/manifest.json for deployment
  serve                     Start the app module (project({ app })) on PORT with adapter-node: what npm start runs
  dev                       Start the dev server: reload on edits, hot CSS and Hozu DevTools
                            (--devtools builder|developer picks its mode, --no-devtools hides it)
  requests [done <n>]       The change requests saved from DevTools (--full: all open ones as one prompt);
                            done <n> --result "<what changed>" removes one
  docs [topic] [--more]     Print one topic of the guide, its short form (--more: options and edge cases too);
                            no topic lists them; docs HZ083 prints one diagnostic; docs components adds the app's list
  migrate [--dry-run]       Upgrade the app from Hozu 0.10 or later: rewrite, raise the dependencies, then (run
                            again after installing) compare the IR and check; never writes the lock
  render <id>               Render one component alone (ui.Button): HTML, root class, owned properties, diagnostics
  skill                     Rewrite the agent skill for this Hozu version (--agent claude|agents|both)
  check [--no-types]        Type-check the app and validate it: the one command to run after every edit
                            (--no-types: rules and contracts only)
  map                       Outline the app (routes, queries, mutations, events, states, views) with file:line
  get <path>...             Request pages in-process (no server): status, title, alerts, visible text, forms
  env [--example]           Every env variable the app reads: side, required, default, set now, internal URL;
                            --example writes .env.example
  call <feature>.<effect>   Run one query or mutation in-process (no server) through the app's own handler:
                            --input '<json>', --session '<json>'; a mutation writes real data and needs --write
  browse <path> --do <step> Run the steps in headless Chrome with and without JS (no server): what each step changed

Change request 26 (export with note numbers, bodies and CSV) is in place. `npx hozu check` passes with no errors or warnings, and all 6 contracts pass. I tried every format on the production server on port 4832, signed in and signed out, and then stopped it. ## 改了什麼 | 檔案 | 內容 | |---|---| | `features/notes/model.ts` | 匯出的每筆筆記改成正好六個欄位：`number`、`title`、`body`、`pinned`、`archived`、`createdAt`
`/api/export` 改由程式直接組出回應，好加上下載標頭
新增 `format` 參數（可省略），以及錯誤 `BadFormat`（回 400） | | `features/notes/server.ts` | 順序和以前一樣：釘選的在前
JSON 的格式和以前一樣，是 `{ user, notes }`
CSV 依 change.md 的規則產生：含逗號、雙引號或換行的值才加引號，引號內的雙引號重複一次，每行都以 CRLF 結尾
內文裡的換行一律輸出為 `\n`
兩種格式都加上 `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="notes-.json"` 或 `.csv` | | `features/notes/views.ts` | 列表頁在 `Export` 旁新增 `Export CSV` 連結，指向 `/api/export?format=csv`
原本的 `Export` 連結網址仍是 `/api/export` | | `hozu.lock.json` | 已用 `--update-lock` 接受，需要您確認的新內容是：
`endpoints notes.exportNotes: now {"mode":"response","failed":{"BadFormat":400,"Unauthorized":401}}` | ## 一個設計上的取捨 - **為什麼自己檢查格式：** change.md 要求未登入時「任何格式」都回 401。如果讓框架檢查 `format`，未登入又帶錯誤格式（例如 `?format=xml`）會先回 400。所以改成先檢查登入，再檢查格式。 - **代價：** 格式錯誤時的回應內容是 `{"error":"BadFormat",…}`，不是框架一般的 `Invalid`。狀態碼仍是 400。 ## 實測結果 | 請求 | 已登入 | 未登入 | |---|---|---| | `/api/export` | 200，JSON 下載 | 401 | | `?format=json` | 200，結果與上一列相同 | 401 | | `?format=csv` | 200，`text/csv`，CRLF 結尾，引號處理正確 | 401 | | `?format=xml` | 400 | 401 | - 測試用了一則筆記：標題是 `Say "hi", Bob`，內文有換行和雙引號。CSV 輸出為 `"Say ""hi"", Bob"`，內文的換行保持 `\n`。 - 用 `hozu browse --js both` 測新增和釘選筆記，開啟和關閉 JavaScript 兩種模式都正常，沒有錯誤。 - 用 `npm start` 啟動，會讀取 `PORT`。 **沒有發現無法運作的地方。** ## 下一步建議 1. **確認 lock 的變更：** 檢查上面那行 `now:`，確定 400 和 401 對應的錯誤符合預期。 2. **檢查 `Content-Type`：** 兩種格式都帶 `; charset=utf-8`（例如 `text/csv; charset=utf-8`）。如果下游系統要求完全等於 `text/csv`，就把它拿掉。 3. **用 Excel 開 CSV：** 實際開一次含換行的內文，確認匯出檔在常用工具中顯示正確。
